mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{targetRoleId}, rp.permission_id FROM sys_role source_role INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = source_role.id WHERE source_role.role_code = #{sourceRoleCode}
INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT #{roleId}, p.id FROM sys_permission p WHERE p.permission_code = #{permissionCode}
